messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2026-03-15T02:12Z for release v2.14.0 completed initial traffic slice (5%). Noted elevated 5xx for /v1/embeddings endpoint from canary pool. Posting logs.
pagerduty-bot: Incident triggered: PD#INC-4127 - Embedding 5xx surge (canary). Pager sent to on-call schedule: oncall-rotations. Link: https://pd.example/INC-4127
oncall-rotations: acked via PagerDuty, taking first pass. I'm on it — will triage the canary. @sre-jen please standby.
sre-jen: joining. grabbing recent logs from canary hosts.
mike-eng: saw similar spike in staging earlier with quantized kernels. Could be kernel selection fallback on short sequences. Will check kernel logs.
sre-jen: pasted logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:11:23Z canary-host-7 kernel: quant_select failed: fallback-oom
2026-03-15T02:11:23Z canary-host-7 inference: 502 POST /v1/embeddings  latency=12.3s
2026-03-15T02:11:24Z canary-host-8 kvcache: invalidation storm
```
ops-luis: tagging network folks — but initial metrics show no infra CPU/GPU saturation. Errors look originating inside runtime on canary image.
emma-pd: customer impact check: early telemetry shows ~0.8% of embedding requests across the region hit 5xx; two paying customers reported increased failures via support. Escalate customer impact if >1% sustained.
oncall-rotations: quick mitigation plan suggestion: 1) Pause canary traffic, 2) Re-route to previous stable model, 3) Kick off rollback of canary. Any objections?
mike-eng: agree. while we investigate root cause, pause traffic and divert. How do we pause canary? deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: Run blocking command to scale canary to 0 traffic:
```
# scale canary to 0
redwoodctl rollout pause --release v2.14.0 --slice canary
redwoodctl traffic set --release v2.14.0 --slice canary --pct 0
```
sre-jen: executing now.
sre-jen: done. Canary traffic set to 0% at 02:18Z. Confirming error rate dropping in prod.
emma-pd: after divert, total 5xx for embeddings back to baseline ~0.02%. Support notified customers and posted status update draft. Need to confirm rollback vs patch.
mike-eng: quick repro locally: running v2.14.0 with short sequence embedding config triggers quant path that falls back to a slower/unstable kernel. Patch likely needed in runtime selection. But we should not reintroduce risk — recommend rollback to v2.13.4 stable.
oncall-rotations: rolling back canary to stable and triggering a full rollback for the staged rollout. Who's taking the rollback command?
deploy-bot: rollback command:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --release v2.14.0 --to v2.13.4 --confirm
```
ops-luis: I'll run the rollback and watch autoscaler/evictions.
ops-luis: rollback initiated at 02:25Z. streaming deploy events.
sre-jen: monitoring metrics: embeddings 5xx trending down as traffic moves to stable. No customer requests failing now per telemetry.
emma-pd: posting interim customer-facing update: "We've paused a canary release after a regression that caused intermittent failures for the embeddings endpoint. Traffic has been diverted to the previous stable release. We're investigating and will share an update within 1 hour." Approving to post.
mike-eng: collecting core dumps and kernel-selection traces from canary hosts for root cause. Hypothesis: quant path picks untested fast kernel for short contexts causing mem corruption under certain batch shapes.
sre-jen: PD incident INC-4127 updated: status = acknowledged -> investigating. Adding timeline notes and links to logs: https://logs.example/canary/INC-4127
oncall-rotations: handing off to morning SRE rotation for post-mortem, I'll remain on channel for any followups. Tagging @emma-pd for customer comms and @mike-eng for root cause fix.
emma-pd: will coordinate support and hit list of affected customers. Preparing RCA template.
mike-eng: plan for next steps: 1) block re-release of v2.14.0, 2) create hotfix branch with kernel-selection guard, 3) run canary in isolated environment with increased telemetry and kernel fallback tests.
sre-jen: marking mitigations complete: canary paused, rollback to stable, customers notified, monitoring alerts suppressed for canary group. Reopen if we see re-occurrence.
oncall-rotations: closing PD page on my side after handoff to morning rotation. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: PD incident INC-4127 status changed to resolved (ack -> resolved) by oncall-rotations at 02:58Z.
emma-pd: filing a post-incident writeup draft now and scheduling a blameless RCA meeting for 2026-03-16 15:00Z. Will include timeline, customer impact, and rollout guard checklist.
mike-eng: one more note for RCA: add automated canary kernel smoke tests to CI and a pre-rollout check to detect quant kernel selection anomalies.
sre-jen: thanks all — documenting final notes and closing thread. If anyone sees residual anomalies, DM me or reopen new thread.
